coverage.name: Adams County
limitations: Read the Adams County 2026 coordinated election TABOR notice (50 pages, certified by the Clerk & Recorder, posted 2026-09-24). It contains issues from City of Aurora (3A, 3B, 3C), City of Northglenn (3H), Westminster Public Schools (4A), Bennett School District 29J (5A), North Range Metropolitan District No. 3 (6A-6D), Adams County Fire Protection District (6E), Central Colorado Water Conservancy District (7B), its Groundwater Management Subdistrict (7C), Greater Brighton Fire Protection District (7D), and Bennett Fire Protection District (7F, 7G). None is an Adams County issue; none is housing-related.

The TABOR notice covers only tax/debt/revenue-retention issues. Any Adams County non-TABOR referred question (e.g. a land-use or charter-type question) would appear only on the county sample ballot, which is 'available October 1, 2026' and was not posted on 2026-09-26. News reports (not official) mention a possible county referral on District Attorney term limits and a non-binding secession question; neither was verified on an official source and neither is housing-related as described. Recheck the sample ballot after Oct 1.

No list of political subdivisions participating in the Adams County Nov 3, 2026 coordinated election is published: checked the Adams County elections page and the 'Information for Coordinating Entities and Candidates' page on 2026-09-26 (the latter describes the IGA process only). The county sample ballot with all county content is posted as 'available October 1, 2026' and was not available on 2026-09-26.

coverage.name: Bennett (town)
limitations: Read the Adams County official 2026 General Election sample ballot posted 2026-09-28. It contains Bennett School District No. 29J Issue 5A and Bennett Fire Protection District Issues 7F and 7G, but no Town of Bennett question. Those district questions are not town questions and do not qualify for this municipal row.

The Town of Bennett website blocked automated access during the 2026-10-04 recheck, so the municipal clerk's own 2026 election information could not be read. Coverage remains source_unreadable rather than none_found.
The Adams County election pages did not provide a separate participating-entities list during this recheck; the official sample ballot was reviewed for all published ballot content.

coverage.name: Northglenn (city)
limitations: Participating: the county TABOR notice contains City of Northglenn Ballot Issue 3H, and the city clerk's elections page states 'City Council has approved the submission of one ballot issue at the Nov. 3, 2026 election'.

Excluded: Ballot Issue 3H (INCREASE IN SALES TAX ON ACCOMMODATIONS SERVICES) raises the accommodations sales tax from 5% to 8% 'WITH PROCEEDS TO BE USED FOR GENERAL GOVERNMENTAL PURPOSES, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO, PUBLIC SAFETY, STREET MAINTENANCE, PARKS, RECREATION, AND CULTURE, AND ADMINISTRATIVE FUNCTIONS OF THE CITY' - a lodging tax not dedicated to housing.
County sample ballot not posted until Oct 1, 2026; the city page's statement that 3H is the only city issue was relied on for non-TABOR content.

coverage.name: Thornton (city)
limitations: Read the Adams County official 2026 General Election sample ballot posted 2026-09-28. It contains only City of Thornton Ballot Question 2A, a charter amendment concerning when a mayor or councilmember vacates office after declaring candidacy for another office.

Thornton's official Elections & Voter Information page gives the same Question 2A text. The question does not create, extend or earmark housing revenue and does not change land use or housing regulation, so no entry was created.
The Adams County election pages did not provide a separate participating-entities list during this recheck; Thornton's official page confirms participation in the county coordinated election.
